config.scope: Twelve additional phase drill games, separate from the 88-game rated/comparison budget: six each for the frozen baseline and selected challenger.
config.notes: Basic material-family conversion drills have no installed tablebase proof. Mirrored cases are paired, not independent families. Practical equality is a finite teacher estimate, not exact WDL. Play to a real terminal result or the fixed ply cap; no evaluation adjudication.
